title: Keyframe Interpolation Method Comparison Viewer
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that loads the animated character model 'Michelle.glb' using GLTFLoader and displays a keyframe interpolation method comparison viewer. The scene allows users to compare how different interpolation methods (Linear, Smooth/SmoothStep, Step/Discrete) affect animation playback on the same character model.

SCENE SETUP:
- Dark background (0x1a1a2e) with a ground plane (0x16213e, 20x20) at y=0.
- Ambient light (0xffffff, intensity 0.5) and a directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) at position (5, 10, 7).
- Camera at position (0, 1.5, 4) looking at (0, 1, 0).
- OrbitControls enabled with damping, target at (0, 1, 0).
- Load 'Michelle.glb' using GLTFLoader. The model should be placed at origin (0, 0, 0). Extract all AnimationClips from the loaded GLTF.

INTERPOLATION SYSTEM:
- The viewer supports 3 interpolation modes: 'linear' (THREE.InterpolateLinear), 'smooth' (THREE.InterpolateSmooth), and 'step' (THREE.InterpolateDiscrete).
- When the interpolation mode changes, iterate over ALL tracks of the CURRENT animation clip's KeyframeTrack array and set each track's .setInterpolation() to the corresponding Three.js interpolation constant.
- After changing interpolation, the AnimationAction must be stopped and replayed from the beginning to apply the new interpolation.

ANIMATION CONTROLS:
- Store all available animation clip names. Default to the first clip found.
- Playback speed is controllable: values [0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0]. Default is 1.0.
- The animation mixer's timeScale controls playback speed.
- A play/pause toggle. Default state is playing.
- A progress bar that shows current animation time as a fraction of clip duration.

UI ELEMENTS (DOM overlay, top-left panel with id='control-panel'):
- A label showing current clip name with id='clip-name-label'.
- Three interpolation mode buttons: id='btn-linear', id='btn-smooth', id='btn-step'. The active one should have a highlighted style (e.g., bright border or background color #e94560).
- A 'Previous Clip' button (id='btn-prev-clip') and 'Next Clip' button (id='btn-next-clip') to cycle through available animation clips.
- A speed display label (id='speed-label') showing current speed like '1.0x'.
- A play/pause button (id='btn-play-pause') showing 'Pause' when playing, 'Play' when paused.
- A progress bar container (id='progress-bar-container', width 200px, height 10px, background #333) containing a filled div (id='progress-bar-fill', background #e94560) whose width% reflects animation progress.

KEYBOARD CONTROLS:
- '1' key: set interpolation to linear
- '2' key: set interpolation to smooth
- '3' key: set interpolation to step
- ArrowUp: increase speed to next tier
- ArrowDown: decrease speed to previous tier
- Space: toggle play/pause
- 'n' key: next clip
- 'p' key: previous clip

STATE MANAGEMENT:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
- modelLoaded: boolean, true once Michelle.glb is loaded
- clipCount: number of animation clips found
- currentClipIndex: integer index of current clip
- currentClipName: string name of current clip
- interpolationMode: string 'linear' | 'smooth' | 'step'
- interpolationConstant: the Three.js numeric constant (2300 for Linear, 2301 for Smooth, 2302 for Discrete)
- playbackSpeed: number (current timeScale)
- isPlaying: boolean
- animationTime: number (current mixer time within clip, i.e., action.time)
- animationDuration: number (clip duration)
- animationProgress: number 0-1 (animationTime / animationDuration)
- trackCount: number of KeyframeTrack objects in current clip
- allTracksMatchInterpolation: boolean, true if every track's interpolation matches the current mode's constant
- mixerExists: boolean
- actionExists: boolean
- frameCount: integer incremented each render frame

Style the control panel with semi-transparent dark background (rgba(0,0,0,0.7)), white text, padding 15px, font-family monospace, z-index 1000, position absolute top 10px left 10px.
physics_constraints: Animation time must remain within [0, clipDuration]. Playback speed must be one of [0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0]. Interpolation constant must be exactly one of 2300, 2301, or 2302. Progress must be in [0, 1]. All tracks must synchronously match the selected interpolation mode.
